# Staple

Read `reference/present.md` first, then `reference/missing.md`, then follow
the broken pointer at `reference/broken.md`.

Scripts: `scripts/run.py` is invoked directly, `scripts/ok.sh` is already
executable, and `scripts/helper.py` is imported, never run.

See [the guide](./reference/present.md) and [the same guide](reference/present.md#section)
and [the top](#overview) of this page.

Notes live in `notes.md`; your project's `package.json` is yours, not ours.

Never checkable, every one on purpose:

- [external guide](https://example.com/docs/guide.md)
- `/usr/local/share/notes.md`
- `~/.claude/skills/other/SKILL.md`
- `@skills/testing/SKILL.md`
- `scripts/*.py`
- `docs/{name}.md`
- `path/to/config.yaml`
- `plans/.../task-3.md`
- `plans/…/task-4.md`
- `../outside/secret.md`
